summary: Iteration 35: AI War Room feature tested. All backend endpoints working correctly. War Room returns composite signal with AI Score (40%), Earnings (30%), Insiders (30%) weighting. Service worker fix verified - no postMessage clone errors. Frontend loads correctly with War Room, AI Hypothesis, and AI Intelligence Hub sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Service worker fix verified: fetch event handler removed, only push notification handlers remain - no postMessage clone errors
War Room composite scoring correctly implements 40/30/30 weighting for AI Score/Earnings/Insiders
seed_data_creation: Created free test user (freeuser_test_35@test.com) for 403 testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI War Room feature is complete. Backend endpoint /api/intelligence/war-room/{symbol} requires Pro subscription (403 for free users). Response includes: symbol, generated_at, overview (sector, industry, market_cap, pe_ratio, beta, 52-week range), ai_score, patterns, brief, earnings (beat_rate, current_streak, quarters), insiders (buy_volume, sell_volume, net_sentiment, buy_ratio, trades), composite (score, verdict, breakdown). Composite scoring: AI Score 40%, Earnings 30%, Insiders 30%. Verdicts: STRONG BUY (>=70), BUY (>=55), HOLD (>=45), SELL (>=30), STRONG SELL (<30). Service worker no longer intercepts fetch calls - only handles push notifications.
